dedupe_keys.name: seismic retrofit of deficient rc shear walls using selective weakening and self centering foundation retrofit

description: Seismic Retrofit of Deficient RC Shear Walls using Selective Weakening and Self-Centering-(Foundation Retrofit) is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Sriram Aaleti, University of Alabama (ua.edu). As part of project funded by National Science Foundation (NSF), we investigated a retrofit solution for non-ductile RC shear walls, which involves converting traditional cast-in-place shear walls into rocking walls through selective weakening and self-centering. Laboratory tests were performed to validate the retrofit concept on a benchmark wall specimen designed to pre 1970s standards. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: Retrofit, RC Shear Walls, Post-tensioning, UHPC, Pre-1970s, Rocking Walls. Published 2022-11-26. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
